purpose: Positioning aid for the preprint; not a benchmark result.

entries.difference: VeriQuery evaluates evidence state after retrieval rather than treating retrieved text as sufficient support.
VeriQuery connects layout-addressable facts to a gated decision contract.
VeriQuery applies abstention to evidence completeness and reports coverage/false-safe trade-offs.
The contribution is an auditable contract shared across retrieval, extraction, and verification; agent orchestration is context.
Evidence-state control evaluated with negative retrieval results, condition-aware extraction, and fail-closed formal stress.
